name: Ard Éireann

attributes.attribute: a peak in the Slieve Bloom mountains of central Ireland
carries the meaning height of Ireland as a mythic anchor

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ard Éireann marks a peak inside the Slieve Bloom range of central Ireland. The phrase translates as height of Ireland. The summit falls short of the tallest point in the land. Myth names that summit as the place where Ireland itself was born. MacKillop lists the headword Éire and calls it a modern spelling of Ériu. The dictionary entry points readers from Éire to the older goddess form. Together the two sources treat Ard Éireann as a geographic anchor that carries a mythic weight. The peak links a real mountain to the origin story of the island.

okr.objective: Ard Éireann is the mythic birthplace of Ireland on a Slieve Bloom peak.
key_results: The name translates as height of Ireland.
The peak sits in the Slieve Bloom mountains of central Ireland.
MacKillop lists Éire as a modern spelling of Ériu.
Myth names the summit as the birthplace of the island.
